clips.title: The story
paras: Azar Stronghammer is a dwarven paladin stationed at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Having completed his own training in the holy arts, he guides newly awakened dwarven champions of the Holy Light and directs promising recruits toward higher instruction in Ironforge.

While paladins are more commonly associated with the great cathedrals of humanity, the dwarves of Khaz Modan have fully embraced the virtues of the Holy Light. Stationed at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, Azar Stronghammer watches over newly inducted dwarven paladins finding their footing amidst Dun Morogh's freezing slopes. Having mastered his own martial and spiritual vows, he serves as an approachable mentor. When a novice shows enough dedication and spiritual maturity, Azar directs them up the mountain path to Ironforge to study under veteran champions such as Tiza Battleforge.
